title: Average the Readings
story: Your sensor dashboard should show an average, even when no data has arrived yet.
lesson: sum(numbers) totals a list, while len(numbers) gives its size. Handle an empty list before dividing.
objective: Return the arithmetic average of readings, or 0 for an empty list.
hint: First use 'if not readings:' to handle an empty list. Otherwise divide sum(readings) by len(readings).
